title: 93. How do I add a logo to my survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I add a logo to my survey.
short_answer: To let your project/company logo appear in the top right-hand corner of your survey, upload an image file to the 'Appearance' section on the 'Properties' page. If you have already published your survey, please remember to go to the 'Overview' page and click on 'Apply Changes'.
